assessments.name: Written test 1
assessments.description: The test consists of one short piece of writing (150 words), choosing on one of the topics provided.

assessments.name: Online Quiz
assessments.description: A timed, online quiz, with multiple choice questions and True/False, testing the basic structures of Italian grammar and vocabulary, learnt.

assessments.name: Written test 2
assessments.description: The test consists of one short piece of writing (150 words), choosing on one of the topics provided.

assessments.name: Speaking test
assessments.description: The test will consist of a short conversation between the student and the tutor, based on the topics studied in the Unit. Students will be provided with practice questions beforehand.
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Listening test
assessments.description: Students will watch a video or listen to an audio file and will be asked to complete comprehension activities in different formats (e.g. multiple choice, true/false, completion etc), all in Italian.
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Reading & Writing test
assessments.description: The test will consist of one reading passage followed by some comprehension exercises in different formats, one short piece of writing, and one vocabulary exercise. To be completed all in Italian.

assessments.name: Grammar test
assessments.description: The test will consist of a series of exercises covering the grammar structures studied throughout the Unit. The exercises will be in different formats, following those of the Workbook.
